definitions.explanation: To physically or abstractly occupy a place, position, or role.

definitions.gloss: to account for; to make up
definitions.explanation: To constitute a certain proportion or percentage of a whole.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
{占|し}める means to occupy a position or to account for a proportion. Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ (to close) and ⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tighten).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [position/proportion]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める: to account for a share
- ⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める: to hold a position
- ～%⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める: to account for ～%
- ⟦{大半|たいはん}→大半：00400_taihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める: to make up the majority
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{占|し}める: to hold an important position

ASPECT (ている):
{占|し}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes an ongoing state ("accounts for" / "holds"), not an action in progress.

USAGE:
Sense 2 (proportions/percentages) is extremely common in news, reports, and statistics.
